page: Gestures Probe, new Shape blocks, never saved
question: X2: where are the steps of a block moved from the left or right margin track, across widths? Pointer sampled every 5px, press 50px in from the block's left and 40px up from its bottom.

fromLeftMargin.rule: Only the last step comes later: 30 to 40px on six wide, 25 to 35 on four. Ours adds 32, for a single block. Inferred: other widths, and a group is not read.

fromRightMargin.verdict: No rule fits. Widths 2, 4, 8 and 10 take their first step at -55, 20px after ours, and four wide stays 40 behind from then on. Six wide is different and repeats: it jumps 3 columns at -20, comes back one at -50, and from -155 is where ours is. Odd widths are not read. Ours keeps the step rule.
